description: The cube is almost solved. The U face is entirely yellow, and the D face is entirely white. The top two layers are solved. However, the bottom row of each side face is misaligned: the front face (red center) has green stickers across its bottom row, the right face (green center) has orange stickers across its bottom row, the back face (orange center) has blue stickers across its bottom row, and the left face (blue center) has red stickers across its bottom row. Solve the cube.
notes: One-move solve: D. Tests basic bottom-layer spatial reasoning.
